subject.title: Control UI: session diff panel (git-backed changes view for a session checkout)

question: Should OpenClaw own the linked git-backed session diff RPC and Control UI panel as a first-party review workflow?
rationale: The capability fits web-frontend ergonomics but establishes a new cross-client Gateway API and core UI surface, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit permanent ownership decision.

options.title: Sponsor the linked PR
options.body: Review and land the candidate after centralizing checkout resolution and confirming bounded protocol, security, and browser behavior proof.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Keep the issue open but redesign it around a smaller generic workspace-read seam or fewer first-party UI entry points.

options.title: Decline core ownership
options.body: Close the paired issue and PR if external git tools should remain the supported changes-review workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the linked PR
recommendation.body: Review and land the candidate after centralizing checkout resolution and confirming bounded protocol, security, and browser behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing evidence is the current session PR-chip and workspace-sidebar history plus authorship of the paired proposal and implementation.
